decision.reason: [ev-bacdc0376810] is a single changelog line saying only that the default logging switched to JSON. It doesn't name the setting that controls the log format, and it doesn't say which components are affected. The proposed exposure relies on a `--log-format` flag and an `ARGOCD_LOG_FORMAT` env var that appear nowhere in the evidence, and it may miss other ways the format can be set (for example a ConfigMap or Helm values). Deciding this needs the PR #21656 diff or upgrade-guide text that names the log-format settings and the components they cover.
